title: The First Spanish Settlement in the Americas Was Built From a Shipwreck

characters.name: Christopher Columbus
characters.locked_description: Christopher Columbus, a tall Genoese mariner in his early forties, long reddish-grey hair to his shoulders, a weathered freckled face with a straight nose, a dark wool captain's cloak over a plain doublet, a flat dark cap

characters.name: Guacanagarí
characters.locked_description: Guacanagarí, a Taíno cacique in his thirties, broad-shouldered and dignified, straight black hair cut level at the brow, a gold band across his forehead, round gold ear discs, a white cotton mantle over his shoulders and a woven cotton waistcloth

characters.name: sailors
characters.locked_description: Spanish sailors of 1492, weathered men aged twenty to forty, loose linen shirts, wool breeches, knitted red caps, rope belts with knives, sun-darkened faces and rough beards

characters.name: Taíno
characters.locked_description: Taíno islanders of 1492, adult men and women with straight black hair, red-brown skin, cotton waistcloths and short cotton wraps, shell necklaces, a few gold ear discs, woven baskets and gourd bowls

characters.name: archaeologist
characters.locked_description: field archaeologists of today, men and women in khaki shirts and wide sun hats, kneeling on foam pads, with trowels, brushes, string-lined grids and white buckets

locations.name: The shore of the wreck
locations.locked_description: a Caribbean beach on the north coast of Hispaniola, pale coral sand, a long sandbank offshore with white surf, green palm and sea-grape thickets and blue mountains inland

locations.name: Guacanagarí's town
locations.locked_description: a Taíno town of thatched round houses, a wide swept-clean earth square, tall palms, ceiba trees, hammocks, cooking fires and drying racks, ringed by green hills

locations.name: The deck of the Santa María
locations.locked_description: the open main deck of a 1492 carrack, wide worn planks, a long wooden tiller bar, coiled rope, a high stern castle with a hatch, rigging and patched sails against the sky

locations.name: A large Taíno house
locations.locked_description: the inside of a large Taíno house, a high conical thatched roof of palm leaves, woven hammocks, carved wooden stools, clay pots and a low central fire

locations.name: The mound of La Navidad
locations.locked_description: a low earth mound above a coastal field, a trodden bare yard on its crown, a few tall palms and thick grass at its foot, the sea to one side and blue hills inland

locations.name: The excavation at En Bas Saline
locations.locked_description: a low grassy mound on a river plain in northern Haiti, string-lined excavation trenches cut into dark soil, wooden stakes, wheelbarrows, a blue tarp tent and palms

key_props.name: Santa María
key_props.locked_description: the Santa María, a broad round-hulled carrack of 1492, three masts, a high stern castle, patched cream sails with a red cross on the mainsail, dark tarred planking and a carved stern lantern

key_props.name: The Niña
key_props.locked_description: the Niña, a small light caravel of 1492, three masts with lateen sails, a faded red cross on a plain cream mainsail, weathered pale timber, a single deck and a low stern

key_props.name: The dugout canoe
key_props.locked_description: a Taíno dugout canoe hollowed from a single dark tree trunk, long and narrow with raised pointed ends, wet smooth wood, adult paddlers kneeling in a row inside

key_props.name: Columbus's journal
key_props.locked_description: Columbus's journal, a thick bound book of rough pages with a worn brown leather cover, a small iron ink pot and a white goose-quill pen

notes: Samostalna epizoda, ideja #37 u docs/ideas.md (dodata 2026-11-16 na korisnikov zahtev: bar jedna prica iz 1492 / ranog novog veka), jedina iz same 1492 na kanalu, el-dorado je iz c. 1537 (region Caribbean, epoha Modern Era, 24. dec 1492 - 27. nov 1493). Faza 04 zavrsena: research.md i script.md (~1052 reci, oko 6.3-7.1 min pri 148-166 reci/min; pravilo od 2026-11-16: plafon 10 min, duzinu bira tema); lockovi, timing i storyboard cekaju narraciju. Rezim shota (still, klip ili mesano) bira se tek iz slike, ne iz kredita. Izvor: Kolumbov dnevnik (Markham 1893, citan na archive.org), Chancino pismo (druga plovidba), Florida Museum (En Bas Saline), Euronews 12. okt 2026; Gutenberg je bio nedostupan. Ispravljena premisa: 'prvo evropsko naselje' je netacno (Nordijci, L'Anse aux Meadows), tacno je 'prvo spansko'. Broj ljudi: 39 po Kolumbovom dnevniku, 44 po zvanicnoj listi iz 1507 (skripta kaze 'by his own count'). Taino strana postoji samo kroz ono sto su Spanci zapisali (Guacanagari kod Chance); skripta to kaze jednom. TACNOST PERIODA: spanske karavele iz 1492 (Santa Maria nao, Nina karavela), mornari u kosuljama i kapama bez ukrasa, Kolumbo u tamnom plasu kapetana, Taino: pamucne pregaće i nakit od zlata, kanui izdubljeni iz jednog debla, hamak, kuce 'caney/bohio' sa slamnatim krovom; bez zlatnih gradova i bez Evropljana u oklopima konkistadora (to je kasnije). Brodolom: mirno more, mesec, greben; bez krvi i bez lesina u kadru (mrtvi samo kao daleka naznaka u polju). Cacique Guacanagari prikazan dostojanstveno, ne kao 'divljak' ni kao zrtva; Kolumbo ni heroj ni zlikovac. Tvrdnja 'bio je naivan/timid' pripada Kolumbu i skripta je prenosi kao njegovu recenicu. Protagonists za publish.md: recenica koja sazima pricu je 'Kolumbo je gubitak broda nazvao srecom, a tvrdjava od njegovih dasaka je izgubljena': glavni su Columbus i naselje (La Navidad / Spanish Town / Fort), ne Guacanagari (vazan lik, ali nepoznat novom gledaocu; sme u naslov kao kontekst, nikad umesto Kolumba i naselja). Naslov imenuje oba ili nijedan, nikad jedan + deo.
